items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And they had Monkey Joe. You ever hear of Monkey Joe? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, it is. I don't remember.

ctx.x: Yeah. I don't know exact neighborhood and all that. I can't remember the address but Lemon played over there he said. And they had Monkey Joe. You ever hear of Monkey Joe? Yeah. Yeah. He was playing over there. Didn't he? I think maybe the Boswell Sisters and all those people. That might have been before your time.
Yeah, it is. I don't remember. But I remember the Boswell Sisters they was on radio. Yeah. Mm-hmm.
